topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Rain drizzles down, steady and grey. Found out my neighbor's living like a king behind those closed blinds. Mind's been racing, trying to fit the pieces. How long he's been sitting on that pile of cash, never giving a damn about the rest of us scraping by. Dunno if I'm shocked, or just tired. People hide, protect their secrets, their wealth, in a city where every face is a mask. I guess we all have our reasons. Maybe it's time I knocked on a few doors, see what echoes come back. Just another night, another case of secrets in the shadows.
